title: Penthouse w/ Heated Pool | Walk to Broadway!
description:
Discover Nashville's charm and comfort in this stunning loft condo nestled within the Illume community. Situated in the coveted Gulch View neighborhood, this modern urban escape provides a serene haven amidst the lively ambiance of Music City. Perfectly positioned minutes from downtown and The Gulch, indulge in the rich tapestry of Nashville's music culture, savory culinary experiences, boutique shopping, and vibrant nightlife, all within reach.

The space
Relax in style at Illume, a spacious one-bedroom penthouse featuring double-height ceilings and a large private terrace. 

✔ Smart TV
✔ A Fully Equipped Kitchen
✔ High-speed Wi-Fi
✔ Free Parking
✔ Air Conditioning
✔ Heating
✔Washer & Dryer
✔Pool
✔Patio

Nestled in Gulch View near downtown and The Gulch, this urban oasis offers access to the city's vibrant music scene, dining, shopping, and nightlife. Enjoy luxe amenities such as a landscaped courtyard, fitness center, and seasonal pool. Embrace contemporary style and sustainability with energy-efficient systems and a green roof. Your light-filled condo boasts flexible sleeping space, picture windows, and a sleek kitchen. 
The designer living area includes a queen sleeper sofa and a 60-inch smart TV. Prepare meals in the well-equipped kitchen and dine at the table for four. With a lofted bedroom featuring a king bed and a smart TV, plus a queen-size sleeper sofa, this condo accommodates four guests. The bathroom features a walk-in shower. Step out onto the spacious private terrace overlooking tree-lined South Street for fresh air anytime.
